versions.changelog:
- Initial release of buy-handshake-domainl skill.
- Register decentralized domains (e.g., .badass, .forever, .fuck, bear emoji) on Ethereum mainnet.
- Uses Impervious Domains contracts for on-chain ERC-721 NFT minting.
- Supports a secure commit/reveal pattern for domain registration.
- Customizable with various TLD options for different vibes.
- Requires ETHEREUM_RPC_URL environment variable for operation.
